title: Native spawn headroom
summary: Every native launch and wake checks at least 1 GiB available memory with a three-second spawn stagger. Shared psutil probes read available memory and swap on every OS without daemon PATH lookup. Enabled swap requires 512 MiB free; disabled swap permits launching with sufficient memory. Low or unreadable capacity refuses before spawning; the launch or wake record names the reason, observed bytes and recovery.
